note: The IEDOM's observatory of bank charges for private customers (its half-yearly report of April 2026, prices at 1 April 2026), Saint-Pierre-et-Miquelon's table: the yearly price of each bank's international deferred-debit card, whose month's spending the bank takes from the account at once, so nothing is carried on it. The banks' revolving credit isn't in the table and isn't kept.
